import numpy as np
from scipy import linalg
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

rng = np.random.RandomState(1137)
n_samples = 500_000
x1 = rng.rand(n_samples)
x2 = 0.3 * x1 + 0.1 * rng.rand(n_samples)
X = np.column_stack([x1, x2])
y = X @ np.array([0.5, 2.0]) + 0.1 * rng.rand(n_samples)
X = X.astype(np.float32)
y = y.astype(np.float32)

est = LinearRegression(fit_intercept=False).fit(X, y)
coef_sklearn = est.coef_.astype(np.float64)
coef_scipy = linalg.lstsq(X, y)[0].astype(np.float64)

X64 = X.astype(np.float64)
y64 = y.astype(np.float64)
rmse_sklearn = float(np.linalg.norm(y64 - X64 @ coef_sklearn))
rmse_scipy = float(np.linalg.norm(y64 - X64 @ coef_scipy))

probe("rmse_sklearn", rmse_sklearn)
probe("rmse_scipy", rmse_scipy)
probe("rmse_ratio", rmse_sklearn / rmse_scipy)
